evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Clinical, detached description of a failure pattern — low arousal, negative valence; no urgency or alarm, just flat registration of a known defect.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Imperative 'must not' / 'must produce' carries heightened arousal and negative valence — urgency-as-worry about a crash and invalid output, not calm satisfaction.
